newsitem.title: USA: Brown Group Famous Footwear Feb sales up.
newsitem.headline: Brown Group Famous Footwear Feb sales up.

text.p: Brown Group Inc said Wednesday that same store sales for its Famous Footwear division were up 4.2 percent in February.
Total sales for Famous Footwear in February were $50.9 million, an increase of 9.1 percent.
Brown Group said its Naturalizer retail division had a 10.0 percent drop in February same store sales, while total sales decreased 10.6 percent to $7.4 million.

"Naturalizer retail's same-store sales declined compared to February sales last year, which were driven by the sell-through of clearance goods and by aggressive promotions," Harry Rich, chief financial officer, said in a statement. "However, fresh product and spring patterns currently are selling well."
He added that Famous Footwear's 4.2 percent rise in February same store sales was "encouraging" in view of the 9.3 percent same-store sales increase a year ago.
"Margins also were improved and early March business is positive," Rich said.
